title: Vanishing Events and Regularity-Conditioned Reachability in Linear Stieltjes Systems
summary: We study linear Stieltjes control systems in which actuation is concentrated at finitely many temporal events, and we ask what happens when one of those events progressively loses its atomic weight in the associated Stieltjes measure. For constant coefficients, ordinary finite-atomic reachability is governed by a truncated Krylov space and is therefore insensitive to the positive values of the event weights.
